formal_statement: ∀ p : Polynomial ℕ, ∃ l : ℕ, ∀ T : PEqualNP.Search.ResLinQTree (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.BPHP (2 ^ l + 1) l) [], p.eval (2 ^ l) < T.size
plain_statement: For every polynomial p there is l such that every tree-like Res(lin) refutation over the integers (semantic weakening allowed) of the bit pigeonhole principle with 2^l+1 pigeons and 2^l holes has more than p(2^l) lines. Open as far as the fleet read: Part and Tzameret (Comput. Complexity 2021) prove tree-like bounds over Q for unary PHP, not for bit PHP; their Thm 44 is vacuous over Q. Target of a Delayer argument.
title: Tree-like Res(lin) over the integers needs superpolynomially many lines on bit PHP
